records.targetBehavior: Generate an image asynchronously through GenClient and finalize it as a durable media asset.
records.visibleResult: Generate an image asynchronously through GenClient and finalize it as a durable media asset.
acceptanceCriteria: generate_image validates model/reference capabilities, submits with authorized credentials, returns a placeholder id, and atomically finalizes result bytes plus generation metadata.

records.targetBehavior: Upscale an existing media asset asynchronously and finalize the output without mutating the source asset.
records.visibleResult: Upscale an existing media asset asynchronously and finalize the output without mutating the source asset.
acceptanceCriteria: upscale_media resolves mediaRef, model caps, credentials, and source preprocessing before submit; it returns a durable placeholder and produces a new media asset on success.
Tests cover unsupported media/model pairs, restart recovery, cancellation, provider failure, and sourceClipId provenance.
